_doc: ONE source of truth for 'what does this booking still owe?' (the rental, and the refundable deposit until it is taken or handed back). Looped by smoke-test.js against bookingDue() in app.js (through mapBookingFromApi, the real row mapper) and by test-payrail.php against booking_owed() in pricing.php, which the weekly digest totals. Add a case here, never to either test. Rows are DB columns; `base` fills what a case leaves out.

cases.name: nothing paid: the rental and the refundable deposit
the first card payment took the deposit with it
the rental paid in cash, the deposit still to take
the rental and the deposit both handed over in cash
part of the deposit handed over in cash
the deposit went back after the stay
a kept deposit was taken, whatever the agreed figure says now
the card took a different deposit from the agreed one
a custom price with its override
override lost: the negotiated total is the rental
override lost, the deposit handed over in cash too
a comped stay still owes its refundable deposit
legacy: marked paid with less recorded
legacy card hold still only authorised
